description: You are a law professor conducting a systematic review on First Amendment free speech jurisprudence. Your Juris-M library contains 14 court cases — some are directly relevant to free speech/First Amendment doctrine, others are unrelated (criminal procedure, equal protection, torts). The relevant free speech cases have inconsistent tags: some are tagged 'First Amendment', others 'expression', others 'free speech', and some have no tag at all. Your tasks: (1) Create a collection called 'Included Studies' and add all free speech/First Amendment cases to it. (2) Create a collection called 'Excluded Studies' and add all non-free-speech cases to it. (3) Standardize the tagging: all included (free speech) cases should be tagged 'free-speech' (hyphenated). Remove the inconsistent tags ('First Amendment', 'expression', 'free speech', 'hate speech') from included items — they should only have 'free-speech'. (4) For at least 4 of the included cases, add a note (attached to that case) describing the case's holding in at least 40 words. Login: username 'ga', password 'password123'.

free_speech_cases: Tinker v. Des Moines Independent Community School District
New York Times Co. v. Sullivan
R.A.V. v. City of St. Paul
Bethel School District No. 403 v. Fraser
excluded_cases: Palsgraf v. Long Island Railroad Co.
